narratives.body: Da Windy City reports that a potential trade for Donte Jackson could transform the Chicago Bears' defense into a Super Bowl threat, though the status of such a deal remains speculative. Separately, the team is preparing to honor former player Mike Ditka during their Thursday Night Football game against the Patriots, with Yahoo Sports and Establish The Run covering the specifics of the tribute.
narratives.headline: Bears explore Donte Jackson trade and honor Mike Ditka on TNF
